note: Both sets correctly capture the 40W/9W/7W light-output equivalence example and the T24 high-efficacy requirement for Harvest Home fixtures. Set B additionally captures the Title 24 requirement that approved high efficacy luminaires be connected to their own switch in the kitchen, bathroom, closet and laundry rooms, which Set A omits entirely. Set A instead repeats the vacancy-sensor bypass requirement twice with only slightly different wording, adding no information. All claims shown in both sets are supported by the page text, so neither set contains a misread or invented value.
remarks: Both sets ignore the LIGHTING LEVELS table at the top of the page (3 FC, 5-10 FC, 30 FC, 50 FC and the corresponding 40W-bulb counts per task), which is arguably the most engineering-relevant content on the page; if these sets are samples, that omission is shared, but if not, both sets miss it.
